name: Sparkling water / seltzer (unflavored)
notes: FNDDS lumps club soda and unflavored seltzer together and carries the club-soda sodium value (21 mg/100 g). name: Sparkling mineral water
notes: USDA analysis of Perrier; the record does not report sugars or caffeine (null; expected 0).
